text:
Priya: Quick question 
I have a receipt from a London taxi on the corporate card but the driver gave a paper receipt with no VAT number. The fare was  18.40. Can we still reimburse?
Ben: If it was charged on the corporate card we can reimburse as long as the bank transaction matches. But UK rules prefer VAT invoice for reclaiming VAT. For employee card transactions we require the VAT number; for corp card it's usually fine.
Jo: @Priya can you upload the photo of the receipt and add a short note: 'No VAT number on taxi receipt; fare reimbursed gross'. That satisfies audit.
expense-bot: Flag: transaction 4f9c-UK-TAXI missing VAT number. Policy: taxi fares under  20 can be reimbursed without VAT doc if transaction is on corporate card and manager signs off.
Priya: Uploaded the photo and added the note. Manager signoff?
Ben: I confirm manager signoff for this trip. Reimburse full  18.40. Marking ADV/EXP row as APPROVED.
Jo: I'll process it in the next batch. Thanks :thumbsup:
